_comment: ANIME-STYLE BATTLE MECHANICS: Battle system that supports emotional storytelling, dramatic moments, and the power of bonds between trainers and Pokémon.

mechanics.name: Bond Power Boost
mechanics.description: When a trainer and Pokémon share a strong emotional connection, battle performance increases.
mechanics.anime_description: The power of friendship and trust allows Pokémon to exceed their normal limits.
anime_examples: Ash's Pikachu defeating Raichu through bond strength
Charizard finally obeying Ash in crucial moments
Pokémon pushing through exhaustion for their trainer
mechanics.activation_quote: The bond between trainer and Pokémon shines brighter than any technique!

mechanics.name: Emotional Type Override
mechanics.description: Strong emotional bonds can overcome type disadvantages through sheer determination.
mechanics.anime_description: When love and trust are strong enough, even type weaknesses can be overcome.
anime_examples: Pikachu's Thunder affecting Ground-types through sprinkler systems
Fire-types overcoming Water-types through intense heat
mechanics.activation_quote: Type advantages don't matter when your heart is in the battle!

mechanics.name: Dramatic Comeback
mechanics.description: When a Pokémon is nearly defeated, emotional determination can trigger a powerful comeback.
mechanics.anime_description: The moment when all seems lost, true strength is revealed through unwavering spirit.
anime_examples: Pikachu's final Thunder against Lt. Surge
mechanics.activation_quote: This is where we show our true power!

mechanics.name: Weather Battle Enhancement
mechanics.description: Weather conditions create unique battle opportunities and challenges.
mechanics.anime_description: Smart trainers use the environment to their advantage, creating spectacular battle moments.
anime_examples: Ash using rain to boost Squirtle's Water Gun
Charizard's Fire attacks intensified by sunlight

mechanics.name: Terrain Battle Advantages
mechanics.description: Different terrains provide unique strategic opportunities for creative trainers.
mechanics.anime_description: The battlefield becomes part of the strategy, offering creative solutions to tough situations.
anime_examples: Using trees for Vine Whip anchoring
Water environments for aquatic Pokémon advantages

mechanics.name: Gym Battle Specialization
mechanics.description: Each gym has unique battle conditions that reflect the leader's personality and type specialization.
mechanics.anime_description: Gym leaders create battlefield conditions that showcase their Pokémon's strengths.

vermilion_gym.leader_style: Aggressive and powerful, focuses on overwhelming force

celadon_gym.leader_style: Graceful and nurturing, emphasizes natural harmony

mechanics.name: Legendary Battle Mechanics
mechanics.description: Battles with legendary Pokémon require special conditions and create unique challenges.
mechanics.anime_description: Legendary Pokémon battles are epic encounters that test a trainer's worthiness.

articuno.worthiness_test: Trainer must show respect for Ice-type Pokémon and nature

zapdos.worthiness_test: Trainer must demonstrate courage and electrical knowledge

moltres.worthiness_test: Trainer must show passion and fire in their heart

mewtwo.worthiness_test: Trainer must prove mental strength and pure intentions

mechanics.name: Rival Battle Evolution
mechanics.description: Battles with rivals become more intense and personal as the story progresses.
mechanics.anime_description: Rival battles reflect the growing skills and changing relationships between trainers.

mutual_respect.battle_style: Epic clashes that push both trainers to their limits

mechanics.name: Team Rocket Battle Chaos
mechanics.description: Team Rocket encounters involve unpredictable elements and comedic chaos.
mechanics.anime_description: Team Rocket battles are unpredictable mix of schemes, gadgets, and slapstick chaos.

battle_patterns.middle_chaos: Plan backfires, causing unpredictable battle conditions
battle_patterns.resolution: Team Rocket's defeat through their own mistakes or hero intervention

mechanics.name: Personality Battle Modifiers
mechanics.description: Each Pokémon's personality affects their battle performance and behavior.
mechanics.anime_description: Just like people, Pokémon personalities shine through in how they battle.

battle_bonuses: Fights harder when trainer is threatened

battle_drawbacks: May not take serious battles seriously

mechanics.name: Evolution Battle Transformation
mechanics.description: Pokémon evolution during battle creates dramatic power shifts and emotional moments.
mechanics.anime_description: Evolution in battle represents growth, determination, and the power of the trainer-Pokémon bond.
evolution_triggers: Refusing to give up despite overwhelming odds
evolution_effects: Emotional boost for trainer and team
anime_examples: Caterpie evolving to Butterfree to save Ash
Charmeleon evolving to Charizard during crucial battle
Kadabra evolving to Alakazam through trade bonds

mechanics.name: Graceful Defeat System
mechanics.description: Even in defeat, trainers and Pokémon can show growth, honor, and learning.
mechanics.anime_description: True victory comes from fighting with honor and learning from every battle.

mechanics.name: Victory Celebration System
mechanics.description: Victories are celebrated in ways that honor both the winner and the effort of the defeated.
mechanics.anime_description: True champions celebrate victory with humility and respect for their opponents.

first_victory.celebration: Joy and disbelief, sharing happiness with Pokémon
first_victory.recognition: Beginner's achievement, encouraging words from others
first_victory.growth: Confidence boost, motivation to continue improving

gym_victory.celebration: Earning the gym badge, respect from gym leader
gym_victory.recognition: Official recognition of skill, entry in gym records
gym_victory.growth: Tactical knowledge, preparation for next challenge

rival_victory.growth: Strategic evolution, deeper understanding of training

championship_victory.celebration: Ultimate achievement, but with humility and gratitude
championship_victory.recognition: Regional fame, responsibility as role model
